description: Land Acquisition - Siyambaladamana, Palugaswewa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land parcels for the Upper Elahera Canal Project. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, types (paddy fields, scrub jungle, etc.), claimants, possessors, and extents. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
